scope: All four nrfx clock APIs execute pinned HAL/NVIC helpers without code/SVC fixtures; exact register read/write traces, control state, ABI, start/stop ordering and bounded LFSTAT transitions
limitations: MMIO models register values and bounded LFSTAT transitions; this is not physical hardware timing or analog oscillator proof.
Canonical bool states only; nonterminating stop loops and interrupt races remain unproven.
O0 preserves native eight-byte state layout; original compiler instructions and full-image linking/byte equality remain open.
